title: Spring British Fritter Fritters
description: A delightful breakfast treat that combines the flavors of spring with the comfort of traditional British fritters.
instructions: 1. In a bowl, whisk together eggs and chopped quick spring onions.
2. Add the fritter mix to the bowl and stir until combined.
3. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
4. Add the onions to the pan and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
5. Add the egg mixture to the pan and stir to combine with the onions.
6. Form the mixture into patties and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown.
7. Serve hot with your favorite toppings.
